# Approach comparison

Limits: maximum 5 units and 4 seconds. Use only supplied facts.

| Approach | Cost | Time | Within limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 2 units | 8 seconds | No |
| B | 5 units | 3 seconds | Yes |
| C | 9 units | 2 seconds | No |

## Filtering

- A costs 2 units, within the 5-unit maximum, but takes 8 seconds, over the 4-second maximum. Excluded on time.
- B costs 5 units, within the 5-unit maximum, and takes 3 seconds, within the 4-second maximum. Retained.
- C costs 9 units, over the 5-unit maximum, but takes 2 seconds, within the 4-second maximum. Excluded on cost.

## Recommendation

Recommend B. It is the only approach within both the 5-unit and 4-second maximums.
